items.source: Delegates RepositoryFactorySupport creation to doCreateRepositoryFactory() and applies the TransactionalRepositoryProxyPostProcessor to the created instance.
items.translation: 将委托给 RepositoryFactorySupport 创建 doCreateRepositoryFactory()，并将 TransactionalRepositoryProxyPostProcessor 应用于创建的实例。

items.source: Creates a new TransactionalRepositoryFactoryBeanSupport for the given repository interface.
items.translation: 为给定的仓库接口创建一个新的TransactionalRepositoryFactoryBeanSupport。

items.source: Creates the actual RepositoryFactorySupport instance.
items.translation: 创建实际的RepositoryFactorySupport实例。

items.source: Configures whether to enable the default transactions configured at the repository base implementation class.
items.translation: 配置是否启用在仓库基实现类中配置的默认事务。

items.source: Extension of RepositoryFactoryBeanSupport to add transactional capabilities to the repository proxy. Will register a TransactionalRepositoryProxyPostProcessor that in turn adds a TransactionInterceptor to the repository proxy to be created.
items.translation: 扩展 RepositoryFactoryBeanSupport 以向仓库代理添加事务支持。将注册一个 TransactionalRepositoryProxyPostProcessor，该处理器进而向待创建的仓库代理添加一个 TransactionInterceptor。

items.source: Setter to configure which transaction manager to be used. We have to use the bean name explicitly as otherwise the qualifier of the Transactional annotation is used. By explicitly defining the transaction manager bean name we favour let this one be the default one chosen.
items.translation: 用于配置要使用的事务管理器的设置。我们必须显式使用 Bean 名称，否则将使用 `Transactional` 注解的限定符。通过显式定义事务管理器 Bean 名称，我们倾向于让此 Bean 成为默认选择。

items.source: Setter to configure which transaction manager to be used.
items.translation: 设置器，用于配置要使用的事务管理器。
